description: Extend T-001 (PreCompact hook) into a three-layer redundancy system: (1) PreCompact hook calls zug_end_session or checkpoint, (2) SessionStart hook injects resume context after compaction, (3) .claude/rules/zug-context.md (from T-012) provides always-on fingerprint injection as fallback. Any one layer can fail without losing session state. Storybloq uses all three; Zug currently has zero.
title: Triple-layer compaction survival — redundancy by design
